        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (0, inner_radius))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (overall_length * 0.2, inner_radius))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (overall_length * 0.4, inner_radius + 2))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (overall_length * 0.6, outer_radius))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (overall_length, outer_radius))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (overall_length, 0))
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = chamfer(solid_body.edges(), chamfer_size)

inner_cyl = Pos(overall_length / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(inner_radius - wall_thickness, overall_length)
solid_body = solid_body - inner_cyl

num_pts = 200
helix_pts = []
for i in range(num_pts):
    t = i / (num_pts - 1)
    x = t * overall_length
    angle = t * (overall_length / thread_pitch) * 2 * math.pi
    helix_pts.append(Vector(x, thread_radius * math.cos(angle), thread_radius * math.sin(angle)))

solid_body = solid_body - thread_solid
